api/Goap.Goap.Resolver.NativeHeap-2.html.title: Struct NativeHeap<T, U> | |
api/Goap.Goap.Resolver.NativeHeap-2.html.summary: Struct NativeHeap<T, U> Namespace Goap.Goap.Resolver This is a basic implementation of the MinHeap/MaxHeap data structure. It allows you to insert objects into the container with a O(log(n)) cost per item, and it allows you to extract the min/max from the container with a O(log(n)) cost per item. This implementation provides the ability to remove items from the middle of the container as well. This is a critical operation when implementing algorithms like a-star. When an item is added to the container, an index is returned which can be used to later remove the item no matter where it is in the heap, for the same cost of removing it if it was popped normally. This container is parameterized with a comparator type that defines the ordering of the container. The default form of the comparator can be used, or you can specify your own. The item that comes first in the ordering is the one that will be returned by the Pop operation. This allows you to use the comparator to parameterize this collection into a MinHeap, MaxHeap, or other type of ordered heap using your own custom type. For convenience, this library contains the Min and Max comparator, which provide comparisons for all built in primitives. public struct NativeHeap<T, U> : IDisposable where T : unmanaged where U : unmanaged, IComparer<T> Type Parameters T U Implements IDisposable Inherited Members ValueType.Equals(object) ValueType.GetHashCode() ValueType.ToString() object.Equals(object, object) object.GetType() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) Extension Methods CancellationTokenExtensions.AddTo(IDisposable, CancellationToken) Object_Extensions.SerializeToFileAt(object, string, Serializer) Object_Extensions.SerializeToString(object, Serializer) Extensions.IsNull(object) UnityValueTypeSerializer.Serializer(object) Utility.GetGameObject(object) Extensions.GetActualType(object) Extensions.ToDouble(object) Extensions.ToFloat(object) Extensions.ToInt16(object) Extensions.ToInt32(object) Extensions.ToInt64(object) Constructors NativeHeap(Allocator, int, U) Constructs a new NativeHeap using the given Allocator. You must call Dispose on this collection when you are finished with it. public NativeHeap(Allocator allocator, int initialCapacity = 128, U comparator = default) Parameters allocator Allocator You must specify an allocator to use for the creation of the internal data structures. initialCapacity int You can optionally specify the default number of elements this collection can contain before the internal data structures need to be re-allocated. comparator U You can optionally specify the comparator used to order the elements in this collection. The Pop operation will always return the smallest element according to the ordering specified by this comparator. Fields DEFAULT_CAPACITY public const int DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 128 Field Value int Properties Capacity Returns the number of elements that this collection can hold before the internal structures need to be reallocated. public int Capacity { get; set; } Property Value int Comparator Gets or sets the comparator used for this Heap. Note that you can only set the comparator when the Heap is empty. public U Comparator { get; set; } Property Value U Count Returns the number of elements currently contained inside this collection. public int Count { get; } Property Value int Methods AssertValidIndex(NativeHeapIndex) Throws an ArgumentException if the provided NativeHeapIndex is not valid for this container. This method will never throw if Unity safety checks is turned off. [Conditional("ENABLE_UNITY_COLLECTIONS_CHECKS")] public void AssertValidIndex(NativeHeapIndex index) Parameters index NativeHeapIndex Clear() Removes all elements from this container. Any NativeHeapIndex structures obtained will be invalidated and cannot be used again. public void Clear() Dispose() Disposes of this container and deallocates its memory immediately. Any NativeHeapIndex structures obtained will be invalidated and cannot be used again. public void Dispose() Insert(in T) Inserts the provided element into the container. It may later be removed by a call to Pop, TryPop, or Remove. This method returns a NativeHeapIndex. This index can later be used to Remove the item from the collection. Once the item is removed by any means, this NativeHeapIndex will become invalid. If an item is re-added to the collection after it has been removed, Insert will return a NEW index that is distinct from the previous index. Each index can only be used exactly once to remove a single item. This method is an O(log(n)) operation. public NativeHeapIndex Insert(in T t) Parameters t T Returns NativeHeapIndex IsValidIndex(NativeHeapIndex) Returns whether or not the given NativeHeapIndex is a valid index for this container. If true, that index can be used to Remove the element tied to that index from the container. This method will always return true if Unity safety checks is turned off. public bool IsValidIndex(NativeHeapIndex index) Parameters index NativeHeapIndex Returns bool Peek() Returns the next element that would be obtained if Pop was called. This is the first/smallest item according to the ordering specified by the comparator. This method is an O(1) operation. This method will throw an InvalidOperationException if the collection is empty. public T Peek() Returns T Pop() Removes the first/smallest element from the container and returns it. This method is an O(log(n)) operation. This method will throw an InvalidOperationException if the collection is empty. public T Pop() Returns T Remove(NativeHeapIndex) Removes the element tied to this NativeHeapIndex from the container. The NativeHeapIndex must be the result of a previous call to Insert on this container. If the item has already been removed by any means, this method will throw an ArgumentException. This method will invalidate the provided index. If you re-insert the removed object, you must use the NEW index to remove it again. This method is an O(log(n)) operation. public T Remove(NativeHeapIndex index) Parameters index NativeHeapIndex Returns T TryPeek(out T) Returns the next element that would be obtained if Pop was called. This is the first/smallest item according to the ordering specified by the comparator. This method is an O(1) operation. This method will return true if an element could be obtained, or false if the container is empty. public bool TryPeek(out T t) Parameters t T Returns bool TryPop(out T) Removes the first/smallest element from the container and returns it. This method is an O(log(n)) operation. This method will return true if an element could be obtained, or false if the container is empty. public bool TryPop(out T t) Parameters t T Returns bool

api/Goap.Goap.Resolver.html.summary: Namespace Goap.Goap.Resolver Classes ConditionBuilder CostBuilder EnabledBuilder ExecutableBuilder Graph GraphBuilder GraphResolver JobResult Node NodeCondition NodeEffect PositionBuilder ResolveHandle Structs GraphResolverJob NativeHeapIndex NativeHeap<T, U> This is a basic implementation of the MinHeap/MaxHeap data structure. It allows you to insert objects into the container with a O(log(n)) cost per item, and it allows you to extract the min/max from the container with a O(log(n)) cost per item. This implementation provides the ability to remove items from the middle of the container as well. This is a critical operation when implementing algorithms like a-star. When an item is added to the container, an index is returned which can be used to later remove the item no matter where it is in the heap, for the same cost of removing it if it was popped normally. This container is parameterized with a comparator type that defines the ordering of the container. The default form of the comparator can be used, or you can specify your own. The item that comes first in the ordering is the one that will be returned by the Pop operation. This allows you to use the comparator to parameterize this collection into a MinHeap, MaxHeap, or other type of ordered heap using your own custom type. For convenience, this library contains the Min and Max comparator, which provide comparisons for all built in primitives. api/GooglePlayGames.BasicApi.SavedGame.C.summary: Enum ConflictResolutionStrategy Namespace GooglePlayGames.BasicApi.SavedGame An enum for the different strategies that can be used to resolve saved game conflicts (i.e. conflicts produced by two or more separate writes to the same saved game at once). public enum ConflictResolutionStrategy Extension Methods Object_Extensions.SerializeToFileAt(object, string, Serializer) Object_Extensions.SerializeToString(object, Serializer) Extensions.IsNull(object) UnityValueTypeSerializer.Serializer(object) Utility.GetGameObject(object) Extensions.GetActualType(object) Extensions.ToDouble(object) Extensions.ToFloat(object) Extensions.ToInt16(object) Extensions.ToInt32(object) Extensions.ToInt64(object) Fields UseLastKnownGood = 4 The use last known good snapshot to resolve conflicts automatically. UseLongestPlaytime = 0 Choose which saved game should be used on the basis of which one has the longest recorded play time. In other words, in the case of a conflicting write, the saved game with the longest play time will be considered cannonical. If play time has not been provided by the developer, or in the case of two saved games with equal play times, UseOriginal will be used instead. UseManual = 3 Manual resolution, no automatic resolution is attempted. UseMostRecentlySaved = 5 The use most recently saved snapshot to resolve conflicts automatically. UseOriginal = 1 Choose the version of the saved game that existed before any conflicting write occurred. Consider the following case: An initial version of a save game ("X") is written from a device ("Dev_A") The save game X is downloaded by another device ("Dev_B"). Dev_A writes a new version of the save game to the cloud ("Y") Dev_B does not see the new save game Y, and attempts to write a new save game ("Z"). Since Dev_B is performing a write using out of date information, a conflict is generated. In this situation, we can resolve the conflict by declaring either keeping Y as the canonical version of the saved game (i.e. choose "original" aka UseOriginal), or by overwriting it with conflicting value, Z (i.e. choose "unmerged" aka UseUnmerged). UseUnmerged = 2 See the documentation for UseOriginal

There are several core concepts involved with saved games: Filenames - act as unique identifiers for saved games. api/Phantom.XRMOD.ActionNotification.Run.title: Enum TrackableTypeEnum | |
api/Phantom.XRMOD.ActionNotification.Run.summary: Enum TrackableTypeEnum Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.ActionNotification.Runtime [Flags] public enum TrackableTypeEnum Extension Methods Object_Extensions.SerializeToFileAt(object, string, Serializer) Object_Extensions.SerializeToString(object, Serializer) Extensions.IsNull(object) UnityValueTypeSerializer.Serializer(object) Utility.GetGameObject(object) Extensions.GetActualType(object) Extensions.ToDouble(object) Extensions.ToFloat(object) Extensions.ToInt16(object) Extensions.ToInt32(object) Extensions.ToInt64(object) Fields [Obsolete("Use TrackableType.AllTypes instead. (2021-05-02)")] All = Planes | FeaturePoint | Image | Face Deprecated in favor of TrackableType.AllTypes. Refers to all trackable types except AllTypes = -1 Refers to all trackable types. Depth = 128 Refers to a point in the depth map. Face = 64 Refers to a tracked face. FeaturePoint = 16 Refers to a feature point (that is, a point in a point cloud). When used as the trackableTypeMask in a the ray is considered to have hit if a cone around the ray intersects with a point in a point cloud. Image = 32 Refers to a tracked image. None = 0 No trackable. PlaneEstimated = 8 Refers to an estimated plane. When used as the trackableTypeMask in a the ray is considered to have hit if the ray intersects with an estimated plane. An estimated plane is implementation-defined, but might not have an exact boundary. It is a guess that suggests the ray is near a surface. PlaneWithinBounds = 2 Refers to the 2D rectangular bounding box that tightly encloses the plane's polygon. When used as the trackableTypeMask in a the ray is considered to have hit if the ray intersects with the 2D box described by the size of the plane. PlaneWithinInfinity = 4 Refers to the infinite plane described by its Pose (a position and orientation). When used as the trackableTypeMask in a the ray is considered to have hit if the ray intersects with the infinite plane. PlaneWithinPolygon = 1 Refers to the 2D convex shape associated with a plane's boundary points. When used as the trackableTypeMask in a the ray is considered to have hit if the ray intersects with the polygon described by the exact boundary of the plane. Planes = PlaneWithinPolygon | PlaneWithinBounds | PlaneWithinInfinity | PlaneEstimated Refers to any of the plane type trackables. Often used with the trackableTypeMask in a the ray is considered to have hit if the ray intersects with any of the plane types.

api/Phantom.XRMOD.BaseFeatures.Runtime.h.title: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.BaseFeatures.Runtime | |
api/Phantom.XRMOD.BaseFeatures.Runtime.h.summary: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.BaseFeatures.Runtime Classes AbstractCommand Base class for commands that requires access to core XRMOD configurations and context data. Provides helper methods for resolving common dependencies from the Ioc Container. ActionBasedControllerManager Use this class to mediate the controllers and their associated interactors and input actions under different interaction states. BaseFeatureModule The core module responsible for registering and managing fundamental XRMOD features. It handles the initialization and disposal of essential services like GLTF loading, event systems, and post-processing. BuildEventSystemCommand Command responsible for ensuring an active Unity EventSystem exists in the scene. It will automatically find an existing one or create a new one with an InputSystemUIInputModule. BuildGltfLoaderCommand Command that initializes the GLTF asset loading system. It subscribes to network mesh acquisition requests and handles shader resource management. BuildGraphQualityCommand Command that applies the project-level graphical quality settings to the Unity engine. Inherits from AbstractCommand to access project configuration. BuildNetworkMeshDownloadCommand Command responsible for downloading 3D mesh files from a URL and caching them locally. Subscribes to the DownloadMesh action notification. BuildOpenBuiltInBrowserCommand Command that enables opening URLs in the platform's built-in web browser or a customized in-app browser. Subscribes to the OpenBuiltInBrowser action notification. BuildPostProcessingCommand Command that configures post-processing settings on the main camera. Enables FXAA, Stop NaN, and Post-Processing as part of the experience initialization. BuildProcessesManagerCommand Core command that manages the lifecycle of multiple XR projects/processes. It handles process registration, space type switching (Shared vs Exclusive), and clean release of project assets and memory. BuildRecorderCommand OBSELETE. Previously used for in-game video and image recording. Users are encouraged to use platform-native recording solutions. BuildRuntimeDebugConsoleCommand Command that instantiates an in-game debug console if the experience is in debug mode. Uses the "IngameDebugConsole" resource. BuildScriptRuntimeEnvironmentCommand Command responsible for initializing the script execution environment. Supports both C# (via IL2CPP/JIT hooks) and Visual Scripting entry points. BuildSendMessageToSDKCommand Command that enables an XR experience to send messages back to the host SDK/App. Wraps the platform-specific callback mechanism. BuildTryAcquireInformationCommand Command that facilitates acquiring native platform information, such as user IDs or device details. Subscribes to the TryAcquireAppInfo action notification. BuildTryAcquireLoadObjectCommand Command responsible for loading Unity Objects (GameObjects, TextAssets) from downloaded asset bundles. Subscribes to the TryAcquireLoadObject action notification. BuildTryAcquireProjectInfoCommand Command that provides information about the current XR experience project. Returns a JSON-serialized representation of the ExperienceInfo. BuildTryAcquireTemporaryCachePathCommand Command that returns the path to the temporary cache directory used by XRMOD for storing downloaded assets. Subscribes to the TryAcquireTemporaryCachePath action notification. DynamicMoveProvider A version of action-based continuous movement that automatically controls the frame of reference that determines the forward direction of movement based on user preference for each hand. For example, can configure to use head relative movement for the left hand and controller relative movement for the right hand. Enums DynamicMoveProvider.MovementDirection Defines which transform the XR Origin's movement direction is relative to.

api/Phantom.XRMOD.Core.Runtime.html.title: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.Core.Runtime | |
api/Phantom.XRMOD.Core.Runtime.html.summary: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.Core.Runtime Classes BaseBuildFeature<T> Base abstract class for modules that provide a specific feature or algorithm decorator. Handles the creation and registration of IFeatureDecorator instances. BindableProperty<T> A generic wrapper around a property that notifies subscribers when its value changes. Provides a simplified Reactive-like pattern for data binding. DataPropertyAttribute Attribute used to mark a field or property as a data-driven property within the XRMOD framework. This is typically used for automatic serialization or UI binding. DontConvertToMonoBinderAttribute Attribute that prevents a specific field or class from being automatically converted or bound to a MonoBehaviour mono-binder within the framework's internal tools. Extentsions Provides common C# Unity extensions for XRMOD. FeatureManager Static manager for registering and managing high-level XRMOD features and algorithms. Acts as a central registry for feature decorators. GameObjectRuntimeTag A component that assigns a custom runtime tag to a GameObject, allowing it to be discovered by the RuntimeTagManager regardless of Unity's built-in tag system. Ioc A simple Inversion of Control (IoC) container for dependency management within XRMOD. Handles registration and resolution of singletons, modules, and commands. IocContainer Static access point for the global Ioc container instance. Provides a convenient way to retrieve the singleton IoC instance. MonoBehaviourSingleton<T> Generic implementation of a singleton for Unity MonoBehaviour components. Ensures that only one instance of the component exists in the scene and provides global access. RuntimeTagManager Singleton manager for finding objects tagged with GameObjectRuntimeTag at runtime. This provides a more flexible alternative to Unity's native tag system, especially across dynamically loaded content. SDKInformation ScriptableObject that stores global SDK information, versioning, and environment settings. This is typically used to identify the SDK's capabilities and target device at runtime. SingletonTemplate<T> Generic singleton template for non-MonoBehaviour classes. Provides a thread-safe way to access a single instance of a class. UIMonoBehaviour Specialized XRMODBehaviour for UI components that requires handling pointer and drag events. Implements standard Unity Event System interfaces. UpdateBatchOptimization XRMODBehaviour Base class for all Unity components within the XRMOD framework. Extends MonoBehaviour to provide consistent lifecycle handling and identification. XRMODObjectPool A runtime object pooling system for efficiently managing the lifecycle of GameObjects. Reduces GC allocations and performance spikes by recycling instances instead of repeatedly instantiating and destroying them. Interfaces ICommand Base interface for command pattern implementation within XRMOD. Provides a standard way to encapsulate and execute specific logic. IFeatureDecorator Interface for feature decorators that encapsulate XR algorithms or specific hardware capabilities. Decorators manage the lifecycle and availability of the features they represent. IModel Base interface for data models within the XRMOD framework. Models are responsible for state management and data persistence. IModule Defines the lifecycle and core functionality of an XRMOD module. Modules represent high-level system components such as AR algorithms, tracking systems, or feature managers. IPassthroughCameraApi Interface for accessing passthrough camera parameters and history poses. Essential for MR experiences that require precise alignment of virtual content with the real world. IPlatformDependenceInject Interface for platform-dependent capability injection. Implementation should handle platform-specific registrations and feature executions. IReleaseCommand Interface for commands that handle the release or disposal of resources. IRuntimeTag Interface for components that implement custom runtime tagging. Provides a mechanism for tag identification and comparison. ISubModel Interface for sub-modules that operate independently of the primary XR module. Sub-models can be dynamically registered, paused, and unregistered to manage resource usage. ITick Interface for components that require regular "tick" updates. Provides an alternative to Unity's Update for decoupled logic processing. IUtility Marker interface for utility classes within the XRMOD framework. Used for dependency injection and identification of helper services. Enums EnvironmentType Denotes the environment context in which the SDK is currently running.

api/Phantom.XRMOD.Localization.Runtime.h.summary: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.Localization.Runtime Classes BaseLocalizationData<T> Base abstract class for all localizable data components in XRMOD. Handles the management of localization keys and scopes. BaseLocalizedImageComponent Base abstract class for all localizable image components in XRMOD. Specializes BaseLocalizationData<T> for Sprite assets. BaseLocalizedTextComponent Base abstract class for all localizable text components in XRMOD. Handles the automatic registration of the component with the LocalizationManager. LocalizatedTextMeshProUGUI Localizes a TextMeshProUGUI component within a UGUI canvas. Requires a TextMeshProUGUI component on the same GameObject. LocalizationAudioComponent Localizes an AudioSource component by updating its AudioClip. Requires an AudioSource component on the same GameObject. LocalizationDatabase A ScriptableObject that stores a collection of localization tables and settings. Acts as the primary database for internationalization data within XRMOD. LocalizationEntry Represents a single localization entry, containing translations for multiple languages. LocalizationImageComponent Localizes a UGUI Image component by updating its Sprite. Requires an Image component on the same GameObject. LocalizationManager The central manager for the localization system in XRMOD. It handles the initialization of localization modules for different scopes and provides APIs for retrieving localized strings and managing language changes. LocalizationManagerV2 Manages localization data and language settings for the application. This class follows a singleton pattern to ensure a single instance throughout the application lifecycle. LocalizationModule Represents a single localization module for a specific project and scope. Handles the parsing of localization tables, management of localizable components, and retrieval of localized assets (strings, sprites, audio clips). LocalizationScopeCompat Provides conversion utility methods between AvailablePlace and LocalizationScope. LocalizationTable Represents a collection of localization entries for a specific scope and platform. This ScriptableObject allows for organized translation data management. LocalizatoinSettings Configuration settings for the localization system, including supported languages and default scope. LocalizedAssetBase<T> Base abstract class for all localizable asset-based components in XRMOD V2. Handles the automatic refreshing of assets when the application language changes. LocalizedAssetLoader Static utility class for asynchronously loading localized assets (like prefabs or textures) from either Unity Resources or XRMOD asset bundles. LocalizedAudio Localizes an AudioSource component by updating its AudioClip in XRMOD V2. LocalizedImage Localizes a UGUI Image component by updating its Sprite in XRMOD V2. LocalizedRawImage Localizes a UGUI RawImage component by updating its Texture in XRMOD V2. LocalizedRendererTexture Localizes a Renderer's main texture in XRMOD V2. LocalizedStringKeyExtension Provides extension methods for strings to easily retrieve localized versions from various localization scopes and modules. LocalizedTemplate A helper class for managing localized string templates that support argument formatting. LocalizedText Localizes a built-in Unity UGUI Text component. Requires a Text component on the same GameObject. LocalizedTextMeshPro Localizes a TextMeshPro component (3D text). Requires a TextMeshPro component on the same GameObject. LocalizedTextWithArgs Localizes a TextMeshProUGUI component while supporting dynamic argument formatting in XRMOD V2. LocalizedVideo Localizes a VideoPlayer component by updating its VideoClip in XRMOD V2. SystemLanguageTextPair A simple pair representing a language and its corresponding localized text. Interfaces IContentComponent<T> Defines a generic interface for components that can have their content localized. Enums AvailablePlace Obsolete enum for specifying the available place for localization. Use LocalizationScope instead. LocalizationScope Specifies the scope or location where localization is applied.

This model is responsible for locating and caching references to cameras, managers (AR, Input, Occlusion), providers (Locomotion, Turn, Climb), and controller transforms. It acts as a central registry for accessing these components. AutoRegisterModule Automatically registers the Meta Quest module when running on a Quest device. BaseMetaQuestFeatureDecorator Base abstract decorator for Meta Quest features. Provides common functionality for registering feature decorators at runtime. Implementations should override StartAlgorithm(), PauseAlgorithm(), and StopAlgorithm(). BuildMetaQuestInteracterSwitcherFeatureCommand Command to build and initialize the Meta Quest Interactor Switcher feature. This command creates an instance of MetaQuestInteracterSwitherDecorator to handle interaction switching. BuildMetaQuestLocomotionFeatureCommand Command to build and initialize the Meta Quest Locomotion feature. This command creates an instance of MetaQuestLocomotionFeatureDecorator to handle locomotion logic. BuildMetaQuestMRFeatureCommand Command to build and initialize the Meta Quest Mixed Reality feature. This command creates an instance of MetaQuestMRFeatureDecorator to enable mixed reality capabilities like passthrough. BuildMetaQuestMeshFeatureCommand Command to build and initialize the Meta Quest Meshing feature. This command handles loading the mesh visualizer (either default or custom) and initializing the MetaQuestMeshingDecorator. BuildMetaQuestOcclusionFeatureCommand Command to build and initialize the Meta Quest Occlusion feature. This command creates an instance of MetaQuestOcclusionDecorator to handle environmental occlusion. BuildMetaQuestSceneCaptureCommand Command to build and initialize the Meta Quest Scene Capture feature. This command creates an instance of MetaQuestSceneCaptureDecorator to handle scene capture functionality. BuildXRAlgorithmLifeControllerCommand Manages the lifecycle of XR algorithms on the Quest platform. Listens for ARAlgorithmLifeCTRL notifications and controls the state (Start, Pause, Stop) of various algorithms such as Meshing and Passthrough. MetaQuestBoundingBoxesDecorator Feature decorator for handling AR Bounding Boxes on Meta Quest. Initializes the ARBoundingBoxManager and listens for trackable changes, notifying the system via ActionNotificationCenter. MetaQuestInteracterSwitherDecorator Feature decorator for switching between different interaction inputs on Meta Quest. Listens for input switch notifications and activates/deactivates corresponding controllers (Hands, XR Controllers, etc.). MetaQuestLocomotionFeatureDecorator Feature decorator for enabling/disabling locomotion features on Meta Quest. Controls the activation of teleport interactors, character controllers, and locomotion providers. MetaQuestMRFeatureDecorator Feature decorator for Meta Quest Mixed Reality (Passthrough). Controls the camera background to enable or disable passthrough mode. MetaQuestMeshingDecorator Feature decorator for Meta Quest Meshing. Manages the ARMeshManager and dispatches notifications when meshes are added, updated, or removed. MetaQuestModule The main module class for Meta Quest support in XR-MOD. This class implements the IModule interface and is responsible for managing the lifecycle of Quest-specific features such as Mixed Reality, Occlusion, and Meshing. It listens for configuration changes and initializes the appropriate systems. MetaQuestOcclusionDecorator Feature decorator for Meta Quest Occlusion. Configures AROcclusionManager settings such as environment depth and human segmentation based on the runtime configuration. MetaQuestSceneCaptureDecorator Feature decorator for triggering Meta Quest Scene Capture (Spatial Setup). Listens for a capture environment notification to request scene capture from the system. PassthroughCameraDebugger Utility class for handling debug logging with varied levels of verbosity. PassthroughCameraPermissions Manages permission requests for Passthrough Camera access on Meta Quest. PassthroughCameraUtils Utility class for interacting with the Meta Quest Passthrough Camera API. Provides methods to access camera intrinsics, poses, and frames via Android Java calls. WebCamTextureManager Manages the creation and lifecycle of a WebCamTexture for a specific passthrough camera eye. Handles permission checks and initializes the webcam texture with the requested resolution. XRConfiguresModel Configuration model for Meta Quest specific features. Contains settings for mesh visualization, occlusion preferences, depth modes, and hand removal. XRControllerVisualizerGroup Represents a group of visualizers for XR controllers on a specific platform. XRControllerVisualizerManager Manages the activation of controller visualizers based on the current platform. XRRuntimeContextDataModel Runtime data model for the Quest module. Stores the state of the AR session, availability, visualizers, feature decorators, and other runtime context information. See SpaceType _processId string The process to switch _boundResizeMode BoundResizeMode Resize mode of the bounded. See BoundResizeMode _dimensions Vector3 The bounded dimensions _boundPosition Vector3 The position of bounded _cullingMask LayerMask Render mask. See LayerMask CleanCache() clean all cache public void CleanCache() ContinueToDownloadAssets() Call this method will continue to download the assets public void ContinueToDownloadAssets() Dispose() Shuts down and cleans up the XRMOD SDK. public bool Dispose() Returns bool true if the SDK was disposed of successfully; otherwise, false. api/Phantom.XRMOD.SDKEntry.Runtime.html.title: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.SDKEntry.Runtime | |
api/Phantom.XRMOD.SDKEntry.Runtime.html.summary: Namespace Phantom.XRMOD.SDKEntry.Runtime Classes AbstractHandler Base implementation for the project loading and disposal chain-of-responsibility. Manages the linking of handlers in a sequence. BuildExceptionCollectorCommand Command that observes Unity's threaded log messages and reports exceptions/errors back to the PhantomsXR backend for debugging and telemetry. BuildExitCommand Command that listens for the 'Exit' notification and triggers the SDK disposal sequence. This effectively stops the current project and returns to the host application state. BuildLoadingUIHandler BuildTryAcquireLaunchConfigCommand Command that facilitates acquiring the custom configuration JSON associated with the current project's launch. Subscribes to the TryAcquireCustomConfig action notification. BuildTryAcquireSDKVersionCommand Command that provides the current version of the XRMOD SDK. Subscribes to the TryAcquireSDKVersion action notification. BuildTryAcquireSdkTypeCommand Command that provides the current SDK device type (e.g., Handheld vs Headset). Subscribes to the TryAcquireSdkType action notification. CacheProjectInformationHandler ConstKey Contains constant keys and values used throughout the SDK, including configuration names, scene tags, network request parameters, and resource paths. CreateUIEventSystemHandler DefaultJsonSerializer Default JSON Serializer implementation using Unity's JsonUtility. DisposeXRMODEngineHandler DownloadManager Manages file downloads using a specified IDownloadStrategy. Provides a high-level API for asynchronous downloads with progress reporting. EncryptStringExtension Extension methods for encrypting and decrypting strings using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) with Rijndael. Used for securing sensitive tokens and license data. ExpericenLoadStateHandler Handler that notifies the host application that asset loading is in progress. FPS FetchXRResourcesHandler Handler that asynchronously fetches XR experience metadata and asset bundle manifests from the backend based on the project identity and target platform. GetXRPackageConfigHandler Handler that downloads and parses the core configuration file for an XR experience package. HandlerExtension HttpClientDownloadStrategy Implementation of IDownloadStrategy using .NET HttpClient. Supports multi-part downloads with Range headers for improved performance. JsonWebToken Provides methods for encoding and decoding JSON Web Tokens. LaunchXRModuleHandler Handler that launches the active BaseFeatureModule once all assets are loaded, triggering the actual XR experience start. LitJsonSerializer JSON Serializer implementation using the LitJson library. ModuleDependenceRegisterHandler Handler that registers all essential system models and commands into the global IocContainer during the SDK's bootstrap phase. OfflineLicenseValidator Command that validates an offline license token. Decodes the JWT token and verifies the application identifier and expiration time. OversizeCheckHandler Handler that validates the total asset package size against the defined maximum limit and triggers a warning callback if the limit is exceeded. SDKEntryPoint The main entry point for the XRMOD SDK. This class provides high-level APIs for initializing the SDK, launching XR experiences, and managing the SDK lifecycle. SDKInitialization Handles the automatic or manual initialization of the XRMOD SDK entry point. This class is responsible for instantiating the SDK prefab and setting initial application settings. SceneDeactivated Subscriber that handles cleanup when an XR scene is deactivated. Releases memory, unregisters models, and handles player unloading. SceneInitialization Subscriber that handles initialization when the main XR scene is loaded. Instantiates the device launcher and sets up initial scene state. SdkVersionCheckHandler Handler that compares the project's required XRMOD SDK version with the version currently running in the host app. Throws an exception if the version is incompatible. SignatureTimeExpirationException Exception thrown when a signed token has expired based on its claim time. SignatureVerificationException Exception thrown when a JWT signature verification fails. Simulater A utility component for simulating XRMOD behaviors within the Unity Editor. Provides GUI buttons to launch/disable XR, clean cache, and test mesh downloads. Utility Provides common utility functions for the XRMOD SDK, including platform mapping, version comparison, and permission requests. Interfaces IDownloadStrategy Interface for file download strategies. IHandler Interface for all handlers in the SDK's project loading and lifecycle pipeline. IJsonSerializer Provides JSON Serialize and Deserialize. Allows custom serializers used. Enums ErrorCode Defines error codes returned by various SDK operations, such as initialization, downloading, and asset loading. JwtHashAlgorithm Supported HMAC hashing algorithms for JWT signing. SceneTags Standard Unity scene names/tags used by the SDK for internal navigation and cleanup.

To change the submit key, either: Go to Edit->Project Settings->Input. Next, expand the Axes section and go to the Submit section if it exists. Change the Positive Button field to the key you want (e.g. space). This flag is primarily used for development and testing in the Unity Editor. public static bool LoadFromRemote Field Value bool Methods LoadAssetFromFileAsync<T>(string, string, Action<T>, Action<string>) Asynchronously loads a specific asset from a local asset bundle file. public static void LoadAssetFromFileAsync<T>(string _pathWithFile, string _wannaLoadAssetsName, Action<T> _loadFinished, Action<string> _loadFailed) where T : UnityEngine.Object Parameters _pathWithFile string The full path to the asset bundle file. _wannaLoadAssetsName string The name of the asset to load from the bundle. _loadFinished Action<T> Callback invoked upon successful asset loading, providing the loaded asset. _loadFailed Action<string> Callback invoked if asset loading fails, providing an error message. Type Parameters T The type of the asset to load (must inherit from UnityEngine.Object). LoadAssetFromPackage<T>(string, string) Asynchronously loads a specific asset from a package by project name. In editor, it attempts to load directly from project assets first, then falls back to asset bundles. public static Task<T> LoadAssetFromPackage<T>(string _projectName, string _wannaLoadedAssetName) where T : UnityEngine.Object Parameters _projectName string The name of the project (which corresponds to the asset bundle name). _wannaLoadedAssetName string The name of the asset to load. Returns Task<T> A Task representing the asynchronous operation, yielding the loaded asset. Type Parameters T The type of the asset to load (must inherit from UnityEngine.Object). Exceptions NullReferenceException Thrown if the asset bundle cannot be found. Exception Thrown if the asset fails to load. LoadAssetFromPackage<T>(string, string, Action<T>) Loads a specific asset from a package by project name. [Obsolete("This method will be removed in future updates. Use LoadAssetFromPackage(Async) instead.")] public static void LoadAssetFromPackage<T>(string _projectName, string _wannaLoadedAssetName, Action<T> _loadedCallback) where T : UnityEngine.Object Parameters _projectName string The name of the project (which corresponds to the asset bundle name). _wannaLoadedAssetName string The name of the asset to load. _loadedCallback Action<T> Callback invoked upon successful asset loading, providing the loaded asset. Type Parameters T The type of the asset to load (must inherit from UnityEngine.Object). LoadAssetsFromPackageAsDictionary<T>(string, string[]) Asynchronously loads a batch of assets by names from a package and returns a name-to-asset map. Delegates to LoadAssetsFromPackage<T>(string, string[]) to ensure assets are loaded and ordered to match the input names, then builds a dictionary in that order. public static Task<Dictionary<string, T>> LoadAssetsFromPackageAsDictionary<T>(string _projectName, string[] _assetNames) where T : UnityEngine.Object Parameters _projectName string The project (package) name. _assetNames string[] The list of asset names to load, in the desired order. Returns Task<Dictionary<string, T>> A dictionary mapping asset name to asset instance. The insertion order of the dictionary follows the order of _assetNames. Wraps a GameObject and an optional component for fast retrieval. PoolManager Manages a pool of GameObjects for efficient reuse. All operations are delegated to an internal PoolManager instance.

api/RootMotion.FinalIK.html.summary: Namespace RootMotion.FinalIK Classes AimController Handles smooth aim target switching, weight blending, target interpolation and root rotation. AimIK Aim %IK solver component. AimPoser Aim Poser returns a reference by direction. AimPoser.Pose the pose definition Amplifier Demo script that amplifies the motion of a body part relative to the root of the character or another body part. Amplifier.Body Body is amplifying the motion of "transform" relative to the "relativeTo". Amplifier.Body.EffectorLink Linking this to an effector ArmIK Arm %IK solver component. BipedIK %IK system for standard biped characters that is designed to replicate and enhance the behaviour of the Unity's built-in character %IK setup. BipedIKSolvers BipedIK solver collection. BodyTilt Procedural body tilting with FBBIK. CCDBendGoal Bend goal object for CCDIK. Add this to a GameObject you wish CCD to bend towards. CCDIK CCD (Cyclic Coordinate Descent) %IK solver component. CCDStretch Automatic stretch and squash for CCDIK. Constraint The base abstract class for all Transform constraints. ConstraintPosition %Constraints to position in world space. ConstraintPositionOffset Offsets the transform from its (animated) position. ConstraintRotation %Constraints to rotation in world space ConstraintRotationOffset Offsets the transform from its (animated) rotation Constraints Contains and manages a set of constraints. EditorIK Updates any Final IK component in Editor mode EditorIKPose FABRIK Forward and Backward Reaching %IK solver component. FABRIKBendGoal Bend goal object for FABRIK. Add this to a GameObject you wish FABRIK to bend towards. FABRIKChain Branch of FABRIK components in the FABRIKRoot hierarchy. FABRIKRoot %IK system for multiple branched %FABRIK chains. FBBIKArmBending Calculates bending direction and hand rotations for a FBBIK rig for VR hand controllers. FBBIKHeadEffector Head effector for FBBIK. FBBIKHeadEffector.BendBone FBIKChain A chain of bones in IKSolverFullBody. FBIKChain.ChildConstraint Linear constraint between child chains of a FBIKChain. Finger Contains a LimbIK solver and some additional logic to handle the finger. FingerRig Handles IK for a number of Fingers with 3-4 joints. FullBodyBipedIK Full Body %IK System designed specifically for bipeds GenericPoser Posing the children of a Transform to match the children of another Transform GenericPoser.Map Mapping a bone to its target Grounder Dedicated abstrac base component for the Grounding solver. GrounderBipedIK Grounding for BipedIK characters. GrounderFBBIK Grounding for FBBIK characters. GrounderFBBIK.SpineEffector Contains the bending weights for an effector. GrounderIK Grounding for LimbIK, CCD and/or FABRIK solvers. GrounderQuadruped Grounding for LimbIK, CCD and/or FABRIK solvers. Grounding Foot placement system. Grounding.Leg The %Grounding %Leg. Grounding.Pelvis The %Grounding %Pelvis. HandPoser Posing the children of a Transform to match the children of another Transform HitReaction Class for creating procedural FBBIK hit reactions. HitReaction.HitPoint Hit point definition HitReaction.HitPointBone Hit Point for simple bone Transforms that don't have a FBBIK effector HitReaction.HitPointBone.BoneLink Linking a bone Transform to this bone hit point HitReaction.HitPointEffector Hit Point for FBBIK effectors HitReaction.HitPointEffector.EffectorLink Linking a FBBIK effector to this effector hit point HitReactionVRIK Class for creating procedural FBBIK hit reactions. HitReactionVRIK.Offset Hit point definition HitReactionVRIK.PositionOffset Hit Point for FBBIK effectors HitReactionVRIK.PositionOffset.PositionOffsetLink Linking a FBBIK effector to this effector hit point HitReactionVRIK.RotationOffset Hit Point for simple bone Transforms that don't have a FBBIK effector HitReactionVRIK.RotationOffset.RotationOffsetLink Linking a bone Transform to this bone hit point IK Base abstract class for %IK solver components. IKConstraintBend %Constraint used for fixing bend direction of 3-segment node chains in a node based %IK solver. IKEffector Effector for manipulating node based %IK solvers. IKExecutionOrder Manages the execution order of IK components. IKMapping Maps a bone or a collection of bones to a node based %IK solver IKMapping.BoneMap Contains mapping information of a single bone IKMappingBone Maps a single bone to a node in %IK Solver IKMappingLimb Maps a 3-segmented bone hierarchy to a node chain of an %IK Solver IKMappingSpine Mapping a bone hierarchy to 2 triangles defined by the hip and chest planes. IKSolver The base abstract class for all %IK solvers IKSolver.Bone %Bone type of element in the %IK chain. Used in the case of skeletal Transform hierarchies. IKSolver.Node %Node type of element in the %IK chain. Used in the case of mixed/non-hierarchical %IK systems IKSolver.Point The most basic element type in the %IK chain that all other types extend from. IKSolverAim Rotates a hierarchy of bones to make a Transform aim at a target. If there are problems with continuity and the solver get's jumpy, make sure to keep IKPosition at a safe distance from the transform and try decreasing solver and bone weights. IKSolverArm A wrapper for making IKSolverVRArm work with other IK components. IKSolverCCD CCD (Cyclic Coordinate Descent) constrainable heuristic inverse kinematics algorithm. IKSolverFABRIK Forward and Backward Reaching Inverse Kinematics solver. This class is based on the "FABRIK: A fast, iterative solver for the inverse kinematics problem." paper by Aristidou, A., Lasenby, J. IKSolverFABRIKRoot %IK system for multiple branched %FABRIK chains. IKSolverFullBody Generic FBIK solver. In each solver update, %IKSolverFullBody first reads the character's pose, then solves the %IK and writes the solved pose back to the character via IKMapping. IKSolverFullBodyBiped FBIK solver specialized to biped characters. IKSolverHeuristic Contains methods common for all heuristic solvers. IKSolverLeg A wrapper for making IKSolverVRLeg work with other IK components and the Grounder. IKSolverLimb Extends IKSolverTrigonometric to add automatic bend and rotation modes. IKSolverLookAt Rotates a hierarchy of bones to face a target. IKSolverLookAt.LookAtBone Look At bone class. IKSolverTrigonometric Analytic %IK solver based on the Law of Cosines. IKSolverTrigonometric.TrigonometricBone Bone type used by IKSolverTrigonometric. IKSolverVR Hybrid %IK solver designed for mapping a character to a VR headset and 2 hand controllers IKSolverVR.Arm 4-segmented analytic arm chain. IKSolverVR.BodyPart A base class for all IKSolverVR body parts. IKSolverVR.Footstep IKSolverVR.Leg 4-segmented analytic leg chain. IKSolverVR.Locomotion IKSolverVR.Spine Spine solver for IKSolverVR. IKSolverVR.VirtualBone Inertia Demo script that adds the illusion of mass to your character using FullBodyBipedIK. Inertia.Body Body is just following its transform in a lazy and bouncy way. Inertia.Body.EffectorLink Linking this to an effector InteractionEffector Managing Interactions for a single FBBIK effector. InteractionLookAt Controls LookAtIK for the InteractionSystem InteractionObject Object than the InteractionSystem can interact with. InteractionObject.AnimatorEvent Calls an animation on an interaction event. InteractionObject.InteractionEvent Predefined interaction events for pausing, picking up, triggering animations and sending messages. InteractionObject.Message Definition of a message sent by an InteractionEvent. InteractionObject.Multiplier Multiplies a weight curve and uses the result for another FBBIK channel. (to reduce the amount of work with AnimationCurves) InteractionObject.WeightCurve A Weight curve for various FBBIK channels. InteractionSystem Handles FBBIK interactions for a character. InteractionTarget The target of an effector in the InteractionSystem. InteractionTarget.Multiplier Multiplies the value of a weight curve for this effector target. InteractionTrigger When a character with an InteractionSystem component enters the trigger collider of this game object, this component will register itself to the InteractionSystem. The InteractionSystem can then use it to find the most appropriate InteractionObject and effectors to interact with. Use InteractionSystem.GetClosestTriggerIndex() and InteractionSystem.TriggerInteration() to trigger the interactions that the character is in contact with. InteractionTrigger.CameraPosition Defines the valid range of the camera's position relative to this trigger. InteractionTrigger.CharacterPosition Defines the valid range of the character's position and rotation relative to this trigger. InteractionTrigger.Range Defines the valid range of the character's and/or its camera's position for one or multiple interactions. InteractionTrigger.Range.Interaction Defines the interaction object and effectors that will be triggered when calling InteractionSystem.TriggerInteraction(). LegIK Leg %IK solver component. LimbIK %IK component for IKSolverLimb. LookAtController LookAtIK Rotates a hierarchy of bones to face a target OffsetModifier Base class for all FBBIK effector positionOffset modifiers. Works with animatePhysics, safe delegates, offset limits. OffsetModifier.OffsetLimits Limiting effector position offsets OffsetModifierVRIK Base class for all FBBIK effector positionOffset modifiers. Works with animatePhysics, safe delegates, offset limits. OffsetPose Definition of FBBIK Offset pose. PenetrationAvoidance.Avoider Definition of avoidance and raycasting info. PenetrationAvoidance.Avoider.EffectorLink Linking this to an effector Poser The base abstract class for all class that are translating a hierarchy of bones to match the translation of bones in another hierarchy. Contains common functionality and static helper methods RotationLimitAngle Simple angular rotation limit. RotationLimitHinge The hinge rotation limit limits the rotation to 1 degree of freedom around Axis. This rotation limit is additive which means the limits can exceed 360 degrees. RotationLimitPolygonal Using a spherical polygon to limit the range of rotation on universal and ball-and-socket joints. A reach cone is specified as a spherical polygon on the surface of a a reach sphere that defines all positions the longitudinal segment axis beyond the joint can take. This class is based on the "Fast and Easy Reach-Cone Joint Limits" paper by Jane Wilhelms and Allen Van Gelder. Computer Science Dept., University of California, Santa Cruz, CA 95064. August 2, 2001 http://users.soe.ucsc.edu/~avg/Papers/jtl.pdf RotationLimitPolygonal.LimitPoint RotationLimitPolygonal.ReachCone RotationLimitSpline Using a spline to limit the range of rotation on universal and ball-and-socket joints. Reachable area is defined by an AnimationCurve orthogonally mapped onto a sphere. ShoulderRotator Shoulder rotator is a workaround for FBBIK not rotating the shoulder bones when pulled by hands. It get's the job done if you need it, but will take 2 solving iterations. If same child, returns same instance. If parent and child have the same registration, the child will create its own instance. When a LifetimeScope is destroyed, objects with IDisposable implemented are called Dispose(). If the scene is alive and only LifetimeScope is destroyed, MonoBehaviours registered as Lifetime.Scoped are not automatically destroyed. If you want to destroy with LifetimeScope, make it a child transform of LifetimeScope or consider implement IDisposable. Singleton = 1 Basically, always returns the same instance. If parent and child have the same type, it returns the instance with the closest scope. When a LifetimeScope is destroyed, objects with IDisposable implemented are called Dispose(). Transient = 0 Instance creating for each resolving. If parent and child have the same registration, the child will create its own instance.

manual/index.html.summary: The Infinite Canvas for Spatial Computing "We are not building a walled garden. We are giving you the geology map and saying: 'Go, this land is free. Build your own empire.'" 📖 Introduction XRMOD is not just an engine; it is an Invisible OS for the Spatial Web. The current state of XR development is broken. Users shouldn't have to download a 500MB app for a 5-minute interaction. Developers shouldn't be locked into centralized app stores. XRMOD bridges the gap between the robust rendering power of Unity and the instant accessibility of the Web. It kills the installation bar, eliminates build times, and democratizes content distribution. With XRMOD, you don't publish Apps. You publish Experiences. 🚀 Core Philosophy The Death of the "App Island" (Instant Experience) XRMOD acts as a Transmission Framework. It separates the logic from the content. Zero-Install: Users access content instantly. No APKs, no IPAs. Dynamic Loading: Leveraging an advanced asset streaming architecture, experiences are loaded on-demand, just like a webpage. Hot Updates: Push changes to your users instantly without app store reviews. Power to the People (Decentralized Ecosystem) We believe in the democratization of the Spatial Web. XRMOD is fully open-source and free. Be Your Own Platform: Deploy your own content server. Create your own specialized "App Store" for vertical markets ( Education, Gaming, Enterprise). Roblox-like Capability: Use XRMOD as a bottom-layer driver to allow your users to create content within your framework. No "Tax": You own the user. You own the data. You own the monetization. The Universal Language (Write Once, Flow Everywhere) Stop porting code endlessly. XRMOD provides a unified abstraction layer. Hardware Agnostic: Whether it's Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest, or a mobile phone, XRMOD translates your intent. Unified API: Develop logic once in Unity, and let XRMOD handle the underlying SDK differences. 🛠 Architecture XRMOD sits between the Native Device SDKs and your Content: graph TD A[Hardware Layer, Vision Pro/Quest/Pico/XReal/Rokid/Mobile] --> B[Unity/Godot/UE Engine] B --> C[XRMOD Engine] C --> D[Your Content,The Experience] D --> E[XRMOD Cloud]
